statistics.posthoc_reason: r19 additions after N-A results; descriptive, no significance claims
statistics.duplicate_resolution: S3-S2 aggregate was planned; new stratified/node-level analysis is posthoc; compute once
statistics.checkpoint: strict minimum inner_val loss best; last separately

strata.aggregate: pooled counts reported separately from equal-fold means
strata.zero_denominator: undefined/null interval; preserve frozen metric convention
strata.interpretation: filename provenance proxy; dependent nodes; intervals descriptive only

special_tables.reentrancy_node: all included non-SolidiFI positives and all non-SolidiFI false positives
special_tables.counts: derive from frozen L-audit; audit discrepancy, never drop rows to match expectation

required_reports: original labels on all original HCG nodes
relative error reduction 1-err(S4)/err(S0o), null if baseline errors=0
anonymous 8H historical reference only, never paired
parameters, relation support, memory and elapsed time
statistics.paired_units: same task/fold/seed and file/node identity; equal-fold means and sample SD; pooled OOF separately

gate_report.rows: available modalities only; no dropout in eval; absent modality excluded
gate_report.S2: no learned gate; compare outcome/representation, never fabricate S2 gate values

statistics.attention: G3R first-layer best eval; S4-noG has zero layers, report not_applicable
statistics.noG: G0 layers=0 removes graph message passing; CTX/STATIC still contain DFG information
statistics.S4m: only ctx manifest masked; CODE original, STATIC unchanged; not full anonymization
statistics.causal_limit: parameters, nonlinear fusion, initialization and optimization differ; not pure semantic causality
statistics.label_caveat: L-audit diagnostic view is not a proven gold standard
statistics.score_interpretation: nested group-disjoint outer folds; full fixed graph transductive forward; no independent external-test claim
statistics.server: separate replication, no mixed device comparisons

training_precision: preserve default TF32; each receipt must record actual flags/device/torch/CUDA
init_provenance: 60 sealed 8H zero-step anchors; no best/last/smoke weights

execution_policy.failure: stop whole batch and retain all evidence; no automatic retry/CPU fallback/graph reduction
execution_policy.oom: move a whole task/all configurations only after explicit user decision; new server batch
execution_policy.successful: verify and reuse within same sealed execution batch
execution_policy.entrypoint: scripts.node_sem.batch_nb_controller; explicit new execution revision/authorization required
execution_policy.runtime_update: explicit independent execution revision, old plan/seal immutable

final_server_intent: Final adequately provisioned server experiments form a separate batch; local RTX3050 limitations are developmental; server not measured
